facts.text: The estate covers 16 acres of lush gardens and a working vineyard.
facts.excerpt: Situated on 16 acres of lush gardens and a working vineyard

facts.text: The estate is 10 minutes from Blenheim airport and 15 minutes from the town of Blenheim.
facts.excerpt: a mere 10 minutes from Blenheim airport and 15 minutes from the town of Blenheim

facts.text: The hotel is at 776 Rapaura Road.
The building is a Victorian convent originally built in 1901 for the Sisters of Mercy and carefully preserved.
facts.excerpt: Originally built in 1901 for the Sisters of Mercy, our historic Victorian Convent has been carefully preserved to retain its timeless elegance.

facts.text: The convent was relocated to its present site in Rapaura, Marlborough.
facts.excerpt: Discover the captivating story of the Convent's relocation to its present location in Rapaura, Marlborough

facts.text: Each room has a spacious ensuite and balcony access with garden and vineyard views.
facts.excerpt: each offering a private haven with spacious ensuite and balcony access, allowing you to bask in the stunning garden and vineyard views

facts.text: Harvest, the onsite restaurant, celebrates seasonal produce from the region and beyond and cooks with a Mibrasa charcoal oven.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a culinary journey that celebrates seasonal gourmet produce from the region and beyond, complemented by unique flavors from our Mibrasa charcoal oven.

facts.text: The gardens have over 400 different native and exotic trees and shrubs that run down to a spring-fed creek flowing through the estate.
facts.excerpt: The  gardens have over 400 different native and exotic trees and shrubs that meander down to a spring fed creek that flows through the estate.

facts.text: The estate's own vineyards grow Merlot, Malbec, Riesling and Sauvignon Blanc, served at Harvest restaurant and in the guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: The estates working vineyards provide us with the Merlot, Malbec, Riesling & of course the world renown Sauvignon Blanc which can be found at Harvest restaurant or in our hotel rooms.

facts.text: A one-acre organic vegetable garden feeds directly into Harvest restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Our 1 acre of organic vegetables feeds directly into our Harvest Restaurant.

facts.text: A garden and vineyard walking tour with the hotel's gardener runs at 9am each morning, with private tours on request at additional cost.
facts.excerpt: 9am each morning or Private Tour on request at additional cost

facts.text: The hotel can arrange private or group wine tours by vehicle, or cycling wine tours.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a tour of your favourites or let us assist you with either a Private, Group tour by vehicle or a Cycling tour.

facts.text: The gardens are a sanctuary for abundant birdlife.
facts.excerpt: This secluded oasis provides a sanctuary for the abundant birdlife.

facts.text: The hotel is a small luxury hotel in the midst of a working vineyard.
facts.excerpt: our small luxury hotel in the midst of a working vineyard

facts.text: Marlborough is at the top of New Zealand's South Island.
facts.excerpt: Marlborough is at the top of New Zealand's South Island

facts.text: The estate has easy access to State Highway 1 and State Highway 6, connecting to Christchurch and Nelson.
facts.excerpt: we provide easy access to State Highway 1 and State Highway 6, connecting you to Christchurch and Nelson.

facts.text: Regional activities can be done self-drive, guided private or with a group, organised by the hotel with partners.
facts.excerpt: Self drive, guided private or with a group let us organise the best options with one of our excellent partners.

facts.text: The hotel describes a blend of heritage and contemporary design.
facts.excerpt: experience the unique blend of heritage and contemporary design.
